title: Bank-Draft Supplement on Security Deposits Interest Accrued to a Refund
content:
Members who pay their electric bills by automatic bank draft earn a supplement on the rate of the interest accrued to the refund date on their cash Security Deposits deposit.

## Terms

The draft-payment supplement reads the account's last twelve whole months of Electric Service by Rate Schedule payments: every service payment by automatic bank draft and no returned payment earns the full draft supplement of **0.10** percentage points; at least half of the payments by bank draft and no returned payment, but not all, earns the half draft supplement of **0.05** percentage points; otherwise none. The supplement is added to the commission rate of the refund-date accrual, in percentage points.

## Conditions in combination

| Service payments in the last twelve whole months | Returned payments in that time | Supplement |
|---|---|---|
| at least one, every one by automatic bank draft | none | 0.10 |
| at least half but not all by automatic bank draft | none | 0.05 |
| fewer than half by automatic bank draft | none | none |
| any | one or more | none |
| no service payment | none | none |

## Hypothetical illustrations

Twelve payments all by bank draft with no return earn 0.10. Twelve payments, six by bank draft, no return, earn 0.05. Twelve payments all by bank draft but one of them returned earn none.
